name: Dorner Blocc Crips
description: The Dorner Blocc Crips (DBC) also known as D-Blocc, are primarily, but not exclusively, an African-American street gang located on the East Side in the Edgemont neighborhood of Moreno Valley, region of Riverside County, California.
